public.intro: Electric light and daylight shape the same rooms. Lutron lighting and shading can be planned together, with the control platform selected around the fixtures, openings and way the home will be used.
public.closing: Lighting begins with the room and its layers. Shading begins with the opening, fabric and mounting detail. Coordinated control brings those decisions together.
